description: Every DC fast charging location on a corridor, in driving order, with mile points, distance from the previous charger, ports and power, plus the corridor's longest gaps and how many miles meet the NEVI 50-mile rule. Colorado corridors: I-70, Denver to Grand Junction; I-25, Wyoming to New Mexico; I-76, Denver to the Nebraska Line; US-285, Denver to the New Mexico Line; CO-82, Glenwood Springs to Aspen; US-40, I-70 to Steamboat Springs.
name: get_corridor_chargers
title: Fast chargers on a corridor
